name: imovies-movie-ticket-booking-platform
description: iMovies - Full-Stack Movie Ticket Booking Web Application

scripts.fullstack: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install

author: Antigravity
